def fn(t0, t1, t2, ta, k, lst, dct):
    idx1 = torch.tensor([13, 3], device=t0.device)
    t0.index_fill_(0, idx1, 3)
    v2 = t0.view((4, 3, 2))
    v3 = t2.unfold(1, 3, 6)
    v3.mul_(0)
    v4 = ta.neg()
    idx5 = torch.tensor([6], device=t1.device)
    t1.index_fill_(1, idx5, 4)
    return (v4, v3, t1, lst, dct)
